title: Cuckoo Clock Surreal Nightmare
description: A surreal painting depicts a melting wooden cuckoo clock with a large blue eye in its face and blue liquid dripping from its structure. Below, two hands emerge from rippling blue water, one with scaled blue skin and the other pale with a ring, reaching toward a large ornate blue key that hangs from the clock's mouth-like opening, which is filled with sharp teeth.
prompt: A surreal dark blue painting of a melting wooden cuckoo clock with a giant realistic blue eye in the center of its face. The clock has a wide open mouth filled with sharp teeth dripping blue liquid. An ornate large blue key hangs from the mouth connected by strings to multiple small padlocks. A black anvil with a quill and feather sits to the right. Two hands reach up from swirling blue water below, one hand covered in blue dragon scales wearing a ring, the other pale hand with long nails and a ring, both reaching for the key. Dark atmospheric background with smoke and dripping effects.
